title: Move a helper into an implementation partition (all-.cppm)
prompt: In this mcpp C++23 modules project, module `calc` has partitions `:geometry` (src/calc/geometry.cppm) and `:types` (src/calc/types.cppm). A private helper `square(double)` is currently defined only inside `:geometry`, but `:types` also needs it for a new exported function `double norm_squared(const vec2& v)` (already added there) — the project fails to build because `:types` cannot see `:geometry`'s private helper. Move `square` into a new, non-exported partition of `calc` (for example `calc:numeric` in a new src/calc/numeric.cppm) so both `:geometry` and `:types` can import and use it, and have both call it from there. The project must build and its tests must pass.
